summary: Tennis tournament Tennis tournament 2025 The Women's Hospital Classic Date 21-27 July 2025 Edition 26th Category ITF Women's World Tennis Tour Prize money $100,000 Surface Hard (outdoor) Location Evansville, Indiana , United States Champions Singles Caty McNally Doubles Arianne Hartono / Prarthana Thombare ← 2024 · The Women's Hospital Classic · 2026 → The 2025 The Women's Hospital Classic was a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor hardcourts . It was the twenty-sixth edition of the tournament, which is part of the 2025 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour . It took place in Evansville, Indiana between 21 and 27 July 2025.
